content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Music online

Most digital commerce platforms, including Gumroad, rely on centralized payment systems that exclude creators from restricted countries like Zimbabwe. In contrast, COREMERCH's sovereign digital commerce stacks use decentralized payment solutions like NOWPayments, which integrates directly with Bitcoin, allowing creators to accept payments from anywhere in the world. This infrastructure shift empowers creators to control their online stores and financial transactions, eliminating reliance on platforms that may block their access.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To deploy a COREMERCH sovereign digital commerce stack, you'll need a GitHub account, a Cloudflare account, and NOWPayments integration. Additionally, you'll require a digital product to sell, such as music, and a Bitcoin wallet to receive payments. The Complete Builder Kit ($197), available for instant download, includes all the necessary blueprints and templates to build, deploy, and scale your sovereign digital commerce stack.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

The product types that work with automated crypto delivery are any digital files that can be stored and delivered via download link: ebooks in PDF or EPUB format, courses packaged as ZIP archives, Notion templates exported as files or share links, font families as ZIP archives of OTF and TTF files, Lightroom or Capture One preset packs, beat files as WAV or MP3 archives, plugin installers, stock photo packs, software license keys, and any other file-based product. The delivery system in Stack 01 uses Google Drive shared links. Stack 02 uses Cloudflare R2 presigned URLs with configurable expiry times — typically 24 to 72 hours — which prevents download links from being shared indefinitely after a single purchase.
By deploying a COREMERCH sovereign digital commerce stack, creators can break free from centralized payment systems and control their online stores.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

The order management layer gives you complete visibility into every transaction your store processes. In Stack 01, every order is logged to a Google Sheet with the buyer's email, product purchased, payment amount in crypto and USD equivalent, transaction hash for on-chain verification, and delivery status. In Stack 02, orders are stored in a Supabase PostgreSQL database with the same fields plus additional metadata. Both can be exported as CSV at any time. The transaction hash provides cryptographic proof of every payment that does not depend on any platform's records — you can verify any transaction independently on a public blockchain explorer.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Scaling a sovereign digital store requires no infrastructure changes at any realistic volume level for most individual creators. Cloudflare Workers processes each webhook event independently — ten simultaneous orders are handled as ten separate processes with no queue congestion. Supabase handles hundreds of concurrent database operations on the free tier. Resend delivers 3,000 emails per month on the free tier — enough for significant daily sales volume. Cloudflare Pages serves the storefront to any number of concurrent visitors without capacity constraints. NOWPayments processes payment volume without per-transaction approval delays.

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
NOWPayments' 0.5% fee is significantly lower than Gumroad's 10% fee, retaining more revenue for creators.

To view available products and shop, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a COREMERCH sovereign digital commerce stack, follow these steps: Create a GitHub account and set up a new repository; Configure your Cloudflare account and integrate NOWPayments; Integrate your storefront with automatic delivery using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script; Set up your payment and delivery pipeline; Test your infrastructure with a sample product; Process your first transaction and send the product to the customer; Monitor your transaction volume and adjust your payment fees as needed.
Frequently Asked Questions
How much does NOWPayments charge compared to Gumroad?
NOWPayments charges a mere 0.5% fee on every sale, whereas Gumroad charges 10%. At 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee difference retains $921.
Can I use other cryptocurrencies with NOWPayments?
Yes, NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, allowing you to accept payments from customers using their preferred cryptocurrency.
What is the difference between Cloudflare and GitHub Pages hosting?

Cloudflare and GitHub Pages both offer hosting solutions, but Cloudflare provides more advanced features like automatic SSL encryption and DDoS protection, making it suitable for high-traffic websites.
How do I configure automatic delivery using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script?

Configure your storefront to display your digital products, and set up automatic delivery by integrating Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script with your payment pipeline. This will enable you to send products directly to customers upon payment verification.
Can I customize my COREMERCH sovereign digital commerce stack?
